import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const b=await chromium.launch()
const errs=[]
async function run(w,h,tag){
 const p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:w,height:h}})
 p.on('pageerror',e=>errs.push(tag+' pageerror '+e.message))
 p.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')errs.push(tag+' console '+m.text())})
 await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/',{waitUntil:'networkidle'})
 await p.click('a[href="#reserve"].masthead-cta').catch(()=>p.click('.hero-btn'))
 await p.waitForTimeout(600)
 // choose the open-worked finish by clicking its row
 await p.click('label[data-config="skeleton"]')
 await p.waitForTimeout(400)
 await p.screenshot({path:`shots/${tag}-selected.png`})
 // the allocation mark should reflect the choice
 await p.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector('#workshop').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}))
 await p.waitForTimeout(500)
 await p.screenshot({path:`shots/${tag}-alloc.png`})
 await p.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector('#reserve').scrollIntoView({block:'start'}))
 await p.fill('#name','Marguerite Bähler')
 await p.fill('#email','mb@example.ch')
 await p.click('button[type=submit]')
 await p.waitForTimeout(600)
 await p.screenshot({path:`shots/${tag}-confirm.png`})
 const txt=await p.textContent('.confirm')
 console.log(tag+' CONFIRM: '+txt.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim())
 await p.close()
}
await run(1440,900,'d')
await run(390,844,'m')
console.log(errs.join('\n')||'no console/page errors')
await b.close()
EOF
